title: Design System: eRakshak Crime OS AI (Ferrari Edition)

display.purpose: Page titles only. Fixed 2.25rem; never a fluid clamp.

headline.purpose: Card and container headers, via CardTitle.

body.purpose: Base size, set on body. General descriptive copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono for status badges, audit trails, data tags.

fontLoading.note: Ferrari Sans and SF Mono are declared but NOT bundled: no font files in the repo, no next/font import. Latin text renders as Helvetica Neue on macOS and Arial on Windows. Only Noto Sans Devanagari and Noto Sans Gujarati are genuinely loaded, via next/font/google in app/layout.tsx.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Default outline for a resting surface.

shadows.name: glow-primary
shadows.purpose: Hairline red ring marking an active surface. Not a blur.

shadows.name: glow-success
shadows.purpose: Hairline emerald ring marking a verified surface.

shadows.name: glow-warning
shadows.purpose: Hairline amber ring marking a pending surface.

shadows.name: glow-destructive
shadows.purpose: Hairline alert ring marking a failed surface.

shadows.name: glow-info
shadows.purpose: Hairline blue ring marking an AI-generated surface.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus token. Components currently express this via Tailwind ring utilities.

shadows.name: elev-raised
shadows.purpose: Full-screen overlays only. A card must never take it.

shadows.name: pulse-glow
shadows.purpose: The one true blurred shadow, reserved for live status indicators.

motion.name: motion-fast
motion.purpose: Button color shifts and immediate feedback.

motion.name: motion-base
motion.purpose: Card border transitions and panel state changes.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out. The only easing curve in the system.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global safety net in globals.css; skeletons flatten to solid #171717.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-signal action on a screen. Ferrari Red, capped at two red elements per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #dc0000; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Ferrari Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: background 130ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c60000; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #b00000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0b0b0b, 0 0 0 4px #dc0000; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined red-bordered action for the second-most-important control in a toolbar.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(220, 0, 0, 0.6); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #fffaf0; font-family: 'Ferrari Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 130ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 130ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(220, 0, 0, 0.1); border-color: rgba(220, 0, 0, 0.8); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgba(220, 0, 0, 0.15); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0b0b0b, 0 0 0 4px #dc0000; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The default panel. Flat at rest; hover transitions border-color only, with no lift and no glow.
components.html:
Case CYB-2291

Reported 14 minutes ago via multilingual intake.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid rgba(52, 42, 36, 0.8); border-radius: 12px; background: #171717; color: #fffaf0; padding: 20px; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #342a24; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Ferrari Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.333; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #a89f91; }

components.name: AI Content Card
components.description: Signature component. Wraps every AI suggestion in a FULL Info Blue border (never a left stripe) with a Sparkles mark and citation.
components.html:
AI-Suggested

BNS 318(4) - Cheating by personation. Grounded in SOP 4.2.
components.css: .ds-ai-card { border: 1px solid rgba(45, 126, 233, 0.3); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(45, 126, 233, 0.04); padding: 20px; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-ai-card:hover { border-color: rgba(45, 126, 233, 0.5); } .ds-ai-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-ai-icon { color: #2d7ee9; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-ai-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 126, 233, 0.2); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(45, 126, 233, 0.1); color: #2d7ee9; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'Ferrari Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-ai-body { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #fffaf0; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Maps a raw status string to the semantic palette. Uppercase mono at 10px, with a pulsing dot for in-flight states.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-warn { border: 1px solid rgba(255, 210, 0, 0.3); background: rgba(255, 210, 0, 0.1); color: #ffd200; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-status-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Soft-border fill with a red focus ring. Placeholder uses Muted Gray Ink, which clears 4.5:1.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search case number or IP" />
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid rgba(52, 42, 36, 0.6); border-radius: 12px; background: #241f1b; color: #fffaf0; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Ferrari Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a89f91; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #0b0b0b, 0 0 0 3px #dc0000; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Content-region loading state. Skeletons, never spinners, outside of buttons.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { height: 16px; width: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #171717 25%, #23130f 50%, #171717 75%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: ds-skeleton-load 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-skeleton-load { 0% { background-position: -200% 0; } 100% { background-position: 200% 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skeleton { animation: none; background: #171717; } }

narrative.overview:
eRakshak is styled as a state-of-the-art threat intelligence console rather than a traditional government database form. It balances a high-tech command-center aesthetic with immediate, low-friction task interfaces for law enforcement officers working under time pressure. The canvas is carbon black (#0b0b0b), the text is warm off-white (#fffaf0), and Ferrari Red (#dc0000) is the single high-signal accent.

The system evokes authority, security, precision, and efficiency. It explicitly rejects the three anti-references named in PRODUCT.md: legacy government search forms and cluttered database portals, saturated cream/sand/beige SaaS palettes, and weak flat hierarchies built on low-contrast gray text.

Because officers are in a task rather than reading a page, this is a product register system. Type is a fixed rem scale (never fluid clamps), motion is 130-260 ms and conveys state only, and consistency across screens outranks surprise.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-mode-only environment. color-scheme: dark is declared globally; there is no light theme.
Ferrari Red as scarcity. Used at most twice per screen, for primary actions and active indicators.
AI transparency. AI-generated content is partitioned in Info Blue with a Sparkles mark and citations back to the source SOP or legal text.
Command density. Lists, timelines, and action queues are compact and scannable rather than airy.
Shell-owned scroll. The app shell owns the only page-level scroll position; scrollbars are visually suppressed.

rules.name: The Twice-Per-Screen Rule
rules.body: Ferrari Red appears at most twice on any given screen. Never as a background wash, never as decoration. If a third red element wants to exist, one of the first two was not important.

rules.name: The Blue Means Machine Rule
rules.body: Info Blue is load-bearing semantics, not a color choice. Every blue-bordered surface is AI-generated and must carry a Sparkles mark plus a citation. Never style a human-authored or raw-evidence surface in blue.

rules.name: The Red-Text Floor Rule
rules.body: Ferrari Red on carbon black measures 3.8:1. It clears AA for large text and fails it for small body copy. Red text is permitted only at heading scale or bold; for small red status labels, use Alert Red (#ff3b30, 5.9:1) instead.

rules.name: The Chroma-Toward-Red Rule
rules.body: Every tinted neutral leans toward the brand's own hue. Never tint toward a generic warm beige. Cream, sand, and parchment canvases are prohibited by name.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Comparison Rule
rules.body: Case numbers, timestamps, IP addresses, account numbers, hashes, and status codes are set in the mono stack. Anything an officer might scan down a column to compare must have fixed-width digits.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Product type does not flex with the viewport. Responsive behavior here is structural - collapse the sidebar, restack the grid, scroll the table - never fluid type.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat when idle. Color and outline respond to state - hover, active, focus, AI-authored, threat - and to nothing else. If a card is glowing for decoration, delete the glow.

rules.name: The 2014 Test
rules.body: If a surface looks like a 2014 app, the shadow is too dark and the blur is too small. This system's answer is to use no shadow at all and shift the border instead.

dos: Do wrap every AI recommendation, prediction, or drafted request in AiContentCard with its Sparkles mark and a citation to the source SOP or legal section.
Do set every case number, timestamp, account detail, and status code in the mono stack so columns compare cleanly.
Do keep Ferrari Red to two appearances per screen, and reach for Alert Red (#ff3b30) when a small red label needs to clear 4.5:1.
Do author type against the Tailwind scale (text-xs through text-4xl), not the legacy --text-* variables.
Do give every interactive element all seven states, and pair every animation with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Do use skeletons for content loading and spinners only inside buttons.
Do keep transitions in the 130-260 ms band on transform and opacity, using cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
donts: Don't use red as a background wash or a decorative highlight.
Don't use gradient text under any circumstances. Gradients belong on data paths - timeline connectors, chart strokes, progress lines - and nowhere else.
Don't use warm, sand-, cream-, or beige-colored backgrounds as a canvas.
Don't build anything that reads like a legacy government search form or a cluttered database portal.
Don't ship low-contrast gray body text. Muted Gray Ink (#a89f91) is the floor, not a starting point to lighten from.
Don't use border-left or border-right above 1px as a colored accent stripe on any card, list item, callout, or alert.
Don't add drop shadows. Shift the border or apply a semantic ring instead.
Don't apply Info Blue to anything a human authored, and don't ship an AI surface without a citation.
Don't scale or lift components on hover. This system's hover vocabulary is color and border, not geometry.
Don't use fluid clamp() type. Responsiveness here is structural.
Don't reach for a modal first. Exhaust inline and progressive alternatives.
Don't introduce a second typeface, and don't set UI labels or data in a display face.
